name: LaSOT (Large-scale Single Object Tracking)
description: A large-scale single-object tracking benchmark containing 1,400 long-term video sequences across 70 object categories, with dense bounding-box annotations. This record is metadata-only and does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Fan, H., Lin, L., Yang, F., Chu, P., Deng, G., Yu, S., Bai, H., Xu, Y., Liao, Z., & Ling, H. (2019). LaSOT: A High-quality Benchmark for Large-scale Single Object Tracking. Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 5374–5383. https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2019.00552

license.identifier: Custom LaSOT dataset terms (not a standard SPDX identifier)
license.notes: LaSOT is distributed under dataset-specific terms rather than a standard SPDX license identifier. Review the current upstream terms and rights in the underlying video content before use or redistribution. This record vendors no data.
